notes:
v4.6.70 — IBKR allocation fixes + cloud IBKR LIVE

💸 ALLOCATION
• Removing an IBKR bot from the allocation table now works for CLOUD bots too — the server market-sells its sub-portfolio, deletes its ledger and frees the cash (before it failed because the desktop had no local gateway).
• Deleting a bot now automatically sells its IBKR holdings and removes it from the allocation table, so deleted bots no longer keep funds allocated.

🔴 CLOUD IBKR LIVE
• You can now run IBKR bots LIVE on the cloud. IBKR sends a Mobile 2FA push on a live login — approve it on your phone and the gateway waits for it (instead of giving up). Paper still needs no 2FA.

Update via the in-app banner.
